commander_identity.primary: Pirate aggro: develop several evasive Pirates and token makers, connect with three different Pirates against one opponent, and steal their best nonland permanent at every end step while Beckett's anthem grows the team.
commander_identity.secondary: Combat-damage card draw and Treasure ramp (Malcolm, Breeches, Coastal-style draw) plus a creature-theft package (Hostage Taker, Coercive Recruiter, Don Andres) that turns stolen creatures into Pirates.

role.advances_plan: Beckett is both the anthem and the theft engine; the deck's evasion, token and Pirate-density choices exist to meet his three-Pirate condition.
role.honest_note: The three-different-Pirates-to-the-same-player condition is genuinely hard to meet through blockers, and the payoff is one steal per end step (two with Roaming Throne). Without evasion the deck is ordinary tribal aggro.
